classifier: exact frozen R91 backbone/head/preprocessing/runtime identity capsule; no training/calibration/threshold or model selection
eligibility: DATA locks source groups before any predictions; no original60 or training/validation/explanation-method-selection use; source/hash duplicate and known patient overlap audit, source-label semantics, license and bound native HU/geometry QA required
sample_rule: floor((j+.5)*native_Z/8), original once-fixed rule; no reference/model-driven selection
metrics: AUROC positive-vs-negative pair concordance,ties.5,undefined unless both classes
balanced_accuracy only with both source classes
sampling_unit: source group, not8 independent patients; patient independence and pretraining overlap remain actual audited statuses
request_status: No executable exact new-case evaluation request until N/list/labels/input identities/code adapter and resources are bound. This is a versioned frozen protocol, not broad approval of arbitrary new groups.
budget_gaps: DATA exact cohort list/SHA and category counts
new-case native bytes/geometry QA and use permissions
complete independent adapter source closure and exact N-derived CPU/runtime/resource limits
normal_branch: all identities/eligibility/permissions pass -> one approved fixed evaluation -> preserve complete positive/negative results, then stop. Any failure stops; no cohort/threshold/model change or retry based on outcomes.
